Arrow Financial Lifted Occidental Pete (OXY) Stake by $321,419; Home Depot (HD) Holder Decatur Capital Management Cut Its Stake 
April 20, 2018 - By Henry Gaston 
Decatur Capital Management Inc decreased its stake in Home Depot Inc (HD) by 13.63% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Decatur Capital Management Inc sold 9,157 shares as the company’s stock declined 7.15% with the market. The institutional investor held 58,050 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $11.00M, down from 67,207 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Decatur Capital Management Inc who had been investing in Home Depot Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $204.12 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.54% or $2.77 during the last trading session, reaching $177.08. About 5.41M shares traded. The Home Depot, Inc. (NYSE:HD) has risen 18.94% since April 20, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.39% the S&P500. 
Arrow Financial Corp increased its stake in Occidental Pete Corp (OXY) by 415.77% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 5,462 shares of the oil & gas production company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $402,000, up from 1,059 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Arrow Financial Corp who had been investing in Occidental Pete Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $58.18B market cap company. Occidental Petroleum Corporation (NYSE:OXY) has risen 4.69% since April 20, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 6.86% the S&P500.
